newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Swiss retail sales fall 0.8 pct in March.
newsitem.headline: Swiss retail sales fall 0.8 pct in March.

text.p: Retail sales in Switzerland, measured by value, fell 0.8 percent in March from the same month last year after a year-on-year fall of 3.7 percent in February and a 2.3 percent drop in March 1996, the Federal Statistics Office said.

But the office said that based on a comparison of shopping days, sales were up 7.3 percent on a daily basis, with two less shopping days in March this year than last year. The difference was related to the timing of the Easter holiday.
Adjusted for inflation, the office said real retail turnover in March fell 1.0 percent below last year, with sales of foods down 0.8 percent and clothes and textiles down by 1.6 percent.
For the first three months of 1997, the value of retail sales was 1.7 percent lower than in the same period of 1996.

Adjusted for prices, the office said real sales fell 2.3 percent in the first three months of 1997 compared with the same 1996 period. This compared with a decline of 0.3 percent in the fourth quarter of 1996 and a rise of 0.6 percent in first quarter of 1996. The office said that the affect of Easter was also a factor in quarterly comparisons.
